emlb.caveat: n = 8. Per-sequence values are not stored for either method, so a per-sequence paired bootstrap is not recoverable from the artifacts; regenerating them costs ~1.6 h for ours plus ~6.3 h of GPU re-inference for EDformer (emlb_edformer_mesr.json wall_seconds = 22546). The exact permutation p-value below is valid at n = 8 and is the primary test; the bootstrap interval is reported for magnitude only.
emlb.note: margin = ours - reproduced EDformer, per cell. 'frozen' is the paper's r = 0.28 operating point; 'matched' uses the baseline's own per-cell retention, read from phase18.

operand_support_minus_magnitude.note: the paper's lead contribution, tested on the held-out real-sensor set. Both operands are ours at the same frozen r = 0.28, so this is retention-matched and exactly paired.

emlb.structure: the 8 cells are 2 lighting conditions x 4 ND levels and are not exchangeable draws from one population; the per-cell margins are listed so the structure is visible rather than averaged away

gap_attribution.hypothesis: the gap is created by beta differing between blocks of one condition, which shifts the score offset and degrades only cross-block ranking
